rules.text: Return one complete schemaVersion 5 object with every required top-level field. No patches, fragments, duplicate properties or unknown fields.

Every schema enum must use an exact canonicalValues string from CUTSCENE_ENUMS_V5.json. Do not abbreviate names, invent synonyms, use legacy import aliases, or write numeric enum values. A normal transition is HardCut, never Cut.

For an existing Cutscene revision, copy contextId, projectId, baseRevision, catalogRevision and requested duration exactly from the latest request context. For a genuinely new Cutscene authored from only the ADD CATALOG package and a creative request, do not ask the designer for contextId, projectId, baseRevision or catalogRevision. Unity owns and binds those values before strict validation; if the schema field is present in a generated example, use only NEW_CUTSCENE_CONTEXT as Unity's import-boundary binding marker. Never copy that marker or another placeholder into a saved revision. Never use a non-empty placeholder projectId. A non-empty projectId from another project must never be silently rewritten.
Every sequenceId, shotId, actionId, eventId, lineId, effectId, audioId, transitionId and entityId must be non-empty and globally stable where referenced.

Every actor, kit, anchor, camera preset and asset reference must resolve exactly. Camera/actor targetEntityId resolves to cast; HideUi.targetEntityId resolves to a ShowUi eventId in the same owner. ShowUi may omit targetEntityId because Unity binds it to its own eventId.
Cast visual assets must satisfy the exact capability required by the cast role and the authored identity.
Sequences may not overlap. Shots may not overlap and must fit their sequence. Nested offsets are local to their owner.
Events are point actions except generated UI presentation. A ShowUi/HideUi pair defines a visibility interval; Unity may derive ShowUi duration from the matching HideUi target.

Follow, Track and Focus require targetEntityId. A cameraPresetId is legal only when exposed by the selected Kit. ChatGPT authors cameraActions only; Unity owns exactly one active CUTSCENE_CAMERA on Display 1, its renderer visibility and root activation. Never invent a Camera asset, Display value or renderer setup.

Spoken dialogue lines may touch but may not overlap. Speaker and listener IDs must exist when supplied. For a visual dialogue preset, choose one exact exported compatibleTuples layout+shotGrammar+cameraPreset combination rather than mixing independently legal values.
VisualWeaponAction, VisualDamageReaction and effects are visual-only. EnableGameplay and DisableGameplay events are forbidden.

ShowUi.assetId must be an exact Ui-primary asset for generated presentation. ShowUi may omit targetEntityId; Unity binds it to ShowUi.eventId. HideUi must target that ShowUi eventId in the same event owner and normally omits assetId. If ShowUi.floatValue is not positive, Unity derives its visible duration from the matching HideUi or from the remaining owner duration. Do not use event.assetId as a generic Layer/overlay route.
Background and FarBackground layers require negative sortingOrder. Do not duplicate a selected Kit background as a free layer.
blocking=true prevents build. Use blocking=false only for genuinely optional content.
A repair response is one complete replacement package based on failedCompleteJson and preserves every valid unchanged item.
